_comment: Planned --detail payload for node configure on listAadGroups1. Connector key: uipath-microsoft-azureactivedirectory. Cannot run node configure without a live tenant; supply connectionId + folderKey from a real IS connection before running uip maestro flow node configure.
configureCommand: uip maestro flow node configure CeqlWhereTest.flow listAadGroups1 --detail '{"connectionId":"<UUID>","folderKey":"<FOLDER_KEY>","method":"GET","endpoint":"/groups","filter":{"groupOperator":0,"index":0,"filters":[{"id":"displayName","operator":"Equals","value":{"value":"active","rawString":"\"active\"","isLiteral":true}}],"groups":[]}}' --output json
openQuestions: connectionId — run: uip is connections list uipath-microsoft-azureactivedirectory --all-folders --output json
folderKey — read Data[0].FolderKey from the connections list output

displayName field must be searchable=true in IS metadata for the where FilterBuilder parameter to be valid; verify with: uip is resources describe uipath-microsoft-azureactivedirectory groups --connection-id <UUID> --operation List --output json
